09110.story: As of Oct 12, the record from 1951 to 2025 on the middle value of the county's 12 grids shows August to September under 90% of normal in 39 of 75 years. In 2025, January to February came in at 64% of normal and November to December at 67% on the middle of the grids. So far in 2026, the middle shows January to February at 53% and June to July at 111%. Every grid had its driest year in 1965, and grid 26032 came in at 61% that year.
